main.name: main
main.description: All icons in a single directory without categorization
benefits: Simple browsing - all icons in one place
Best for small collections or alphabetical browsing
main.useCase: Quick access when you know exactly which icon you need

proposal-1-role-based.name: proposal-1-role-based
proposal-1-role-based.description: Icons organized by developer roles and job functions
benefits: Aligns with team structure and job roles
Easy to find icons relevant to your position
proposal-1-role-based.useCase: "I'm a backend developer, show me my stack" or "What tools do data scientists use?"

proposal-2-layer-based.name: proposal-2-layer-based
proposal-2-layer-based.description: Icons organized by technical architecture layers
benefits: Easy to build stack from bottom-up
proposal-2-layer-based.useCase: "What's in my data layer?" or "Show me all UI technologies"

proposal-3-ecosystem-based.name: proposal-3-ecosystem-based
proposal-3-ecosystem-based.description: Icons grouped by technology families and ecosystems
benefits: Reflects how developers identify ("I'm a React developer")
proposal-3-ecosystem-based.useCase: "Give me all React-related tools" or "What's in the Python ecosystem?"

proposal-4-usecase-based.name: proposal-4-usecase-based
proposal-4-usecase-based.description: Icons organized by practical application scenarios
benefits: Easy to find tools for specific projects
proposal-4-usecase-based.useCase: "I'm building a mobile app, what do I need?" or "Show me data science tools"
